analysis:
Interpretation, not graph proof. The three developments do different jobs. The broken pattern (en-unreturned-island) is the causal owner: it supplies rupture, the series question and the pressure that the other two need. Bond maintenance (en-bond-maintenance) supplies the repeated action families (reaching out, keeping faith, repairing) and carries warm belonging and ordinary generous heroism; it makes the rupture matter. The explicability question (q-migration-explicability) is not an engine but a dial on the mystery's payoff: how much the world is explained by the end, which governs the wonder-versus-mechanism tension recorded in gi-mystery-tension-fantasy.

Reinforcement: the engine tests the bonds (l-engine-bonds), and the bonds give the engine emotional cost, so loss is grief rather than puzzle. Complication: explanation pulls toward investigation and outward voyages, while bonds pull toward home and intimate texture; the fantasy-constrains-exploration interaction already limits that pull. Transformation: a partial explanation can change which practices are needed (if the order is learnable, customs might be re-founded on new knowledge; if not, practices become the way of living with irreducible uncertainty). What only the interaction opens: belonging re-understood through knowledge, where communities learn that their customs encoded the world's order, or learn that faithfulness was never premised on understanding. Neither bonds alone nor explanation alone produces that reframing of earlier warmth.

Independence to keep: the bonds' arc (thr-practices-tested) should not require any particular explicability answer; the explicability answer should not depend on whether bonds succeed; and neither should settle the island's fate (q-missing-island-fate), which is a separate open question.

Sequence A, explicability early, bonds tested afterward. Easier: fair-play clue planting, a strong investigative spine, and early momentum for the mystery genre and the voyage ring. Rival interpretations get concrete material sooner. Harder: the governing wonder promise is exposed to disenchantment early; readers may not yet care about the communities, so later strain on bonds arrives with less accumulated warmth; it also commits the author earlier toward an explicable order (int-migration-has-order), narrowing the enduringly mysterious option. Reader experience: curiosity and intellectual engagement first, then consequence. Opens: late Books in which knowledge enables rescue or repair; reframing of customs as encoded knowledge. Closes or weakens: a late major reframing (the supporting mystery contract expects partial revelations before a late reframing), and an ending in which mystery endures as a deliberate value.

Sequence B, bonds first, loss felt before explanation is sought. Easier: matches the recorded phase order (ph-living-with-migration, ph-absence-registers) and the earned-hope and absence-grief targets; grief, interpretive anger and consequential choice land harder because readers already love what is strained. It keeps the explicability dial open longest. Harder: the mystery may feel slow; early Books need local questions (st-book-dual-question) to carry momentum; clues must still be planted early, quietly, inside domestic texture, or late explanation will feel unearned. Reader experience: belonging and grief first, curiosity rising from care. Opens: any explicability outcome, a late reframing that revalues earlier warmth, and the possibility that practices themselves hold clues. Closes or weakens: an investigation-led opening hook and early exploration scale.

On balance, B aligns more closely with recorded guidance, but A is coherent if the author wants the mystery to be locally dominant earlier. A hybrid is possible: bonds established first while clues are hidden in customs, with explanation sought only after loss.

recorded_observations.claim: Recorded as the causal owner of the series question, renewable because each partial answer reopens what else was assumed stable. In this portfolio it contributes rupture and pressure; the other two developments depend on it, not the reverse.

Recorded as a subordinate layer whose practices are tested by the disappearance and by shifting proximity (l-engine-bonds, l-uncertainty-bonds). It contributes action families and the warmth that gives loss weight; its arc can run without any particular explicability answer.

Open author question; the working reading int-migration-has-order leans toward progressive explanation but requires an author decision. Sequence A pre-commits toward explicability earlier; Sequence B keeps all three outcomes open longer.
Records the risk that over-explanation disenchants the governing wonder promise. Developing explicability early raises exposure to this risk before warmth and wonder are secured.
The recorded phase order plants customs and the trusted regularity before the rupture, which aligns with Sequence B: bonds established before the loss and before explanation is sought.

The supporting mystery contract expects partial revelations before a major late reframing and clues planted early. Sequence B needs clues hidden in early domestic texture to satisfy this; Sequence A risks spending reframing power early.

Warm belonging gives choices weight. Under Sequence B this link is charged before divisions begin; under Sequence A consequential choices may arrive before readers care enough for their costs to land.
Agent-proposed contrasting target realized through incomplete familiar practices. It depends on readers first knowing the complete practice, which favours establishing bonds before the loss.

hypotheses.title: Customs as encoded knowledge
hypotheses.description: Interpretive reading of the interaction: migration-era practices preserve fragments of the world's order, so investigation eventually reveals that the bonds already carried understanding. This joins explicability and bonds without making either depend on the other's success, and enables a late reframing that deepens rather than cheapens earlier warmth. It presumes at least partial explicability.

hypotheses.title: Faithfulness without explanation
hypotheses.description: Alternative reading: the bonds prove that belonging never required understanding. Explicability remains partial or enduringly mysterious, and the payoff is communities choosing care under irreducible uncertainty. Favoured by Sequence B; it keeps the wonder promise safest but asks the mystery contract to be satisfied by meaning rather than mechanism.

hypotheses.title: Hybrid sequence: bonds first, clues hidden in texture
hypotheses.description: A structural reading combining both sequences: early Books establish bonds and loss while planting fair-play clues inside markets, celebrations and craft; explanation is pursued only after grief is felt, and its partial answers arrive in the outward rings. It preserves early warmth and late reframing, at the cost of slower early mystery momentum.

uncertainties: The author has not decided how far the migrations are explained; Sequence A narrows this choice earlier than Sequence B.
Engine hierarchy is UNKNOWN; primary_with_layers is an agent proposal, so the subordination of bonds to the broken pattern is provisional.
Book autonomy is open; Sequence B relies more heavily on local Book questions to sustain early momentum.
The missing island's fate is a separate open question and should not be settled by either sequence.
Ring boundaries and Book counts per ring are unknown, so where explanation lands across twelve Books cannot be placed precisely.
Whether the absent community perspective opportunity is adopted would change how explicability and bonds interact.
